note_extern_fn_sites: Raised 3517 -> 3518 for free_list.zig's own `extern fn xcopy` (REPORT-28 M7.2). free_list previously reached xcopy by importing char_string.zig -- a 1047-line DISPLAY file that merely re-declares the same extern. xcopy is defined in core/state/base/byte_copy.zig, force-imported by core/state/state.zig: a DIFFERENT build root. Cross-object references must be extern (an @import would compile the owner into both objects and collide at link), which is why all 12 other core consumers declare it locally. The extern relationship already existed; it was being borrowed from an unrelated display file rather than declared where it is used. The trade is one honest extern site for one spurious module edge into display code.
